business_problem: AGIT needed to scale a managed security operations center that could meet Indonesian data-residency requirements, reduce noisy alert handling, and standardize detection engineering for enterprise customers.
solution_summary: PT Astra Graphia IT uses Google Cloud to address this challenge: AGIT needed to scale a managed security operations center that could meet Indonesian data-residency requirements, reduce noisy alert handling, and standardize detection engineering for enterprise customers. Google SecOps anchors the managed SOC for threat detection, investigation, and response inside the Indonesia region, serving as the serving layer. Gemini assists triage workflows and helps analysts respond to incidents faster, serving as the compute layer. Mandiant provides the detection engineering framework, assessments, playbooks, and operational uplift used to improve SOC maturity, serving as the governance layer. Identity and Access Management Workforce Identity Federation enforces tightly controlled access across the platform and backend integrations, serving as the governance layer. Compute Engine supports backend integrations used by the managed SOC platform, serving as the compute layer.
products_used: Identity and Access Management Workforce Identity Federation
